operator_statement:
1. Consent, 2026-09-07, in answer to a question that offered the whole corpus, the people-free subset, or refusal, with the statistical consequence of each stated before the choice was made:
"весь корпус (52 фото, максимальная статистическая сила)"

2. REAFFIRMATION, 2026-09-07, given AFTER the corrected people survey existed and was reported to the operator. It followed the operator's own question -- "по поводу людей в кадре, ты должен понимать если это реальные люди или посторы на стенах клуба" -- which is what caused the survey to be redone; the corrected counts (21 of 52 with real people, 5 with a fully legible face, among them "тренер и двое детей") were in the published report and in section 3 of the pre-registration when this was said:
"пуш и продолжай ГО"

groq_data_controls.recorded_from: the operator's own Groq console, Data Controls page, screenshot supplied 2026-09-07; there is no data-controls API endpoint and /models carries no retention field, so the console is the only source

notes:
WHY THE REAFFIRMATION MATTERS AND IS RECORDED SEPARATELY. The first consent was given against a people count of 3 that I had produced by eye. It was wrong by 18: the corrected per-photograph survey (core/plans/RECOG_SO1_PEOPLE_SURVEY_2026-09-07.csv) found 21 of 52 photographs with real people, 22 with printed human figures that are not people, 10 with both, and 5 in which a face is fully legible -- a trainer and two children. Consent given against a materially understated privacy fact is not consent to the real thing, so this record binds the operator's later statement, made once the corrected facts were in front of them, rather than resting on the first one alone.

WHAT THE PEOPLE-FREE ALTERNATIVE WOULD HAVE COST, stated to the operator before they chose: the source-level people-free subset holds 16 and 15 unique source photographs per ground-truth kind, both below the pre-registered power floor of 20, so that branch was pre-registered to return INCONCLUSIVE whatever Qwen produced. The whole corpus was the only option that could reach a verdict, and the operator was told so before answering.

PROVIDER RETENTION was read from the operator's own Groq console and recorded in groq_data_controls below; it is not readable from the API. The Groq API key used for this run is treated as COMPROMISED because it passed through a chat transcript. It lives only outside this repository, appears in no committed file, no log line and no report, and revoking it is the operator's own action.

SCOPE. This authorises transmitting exactly the 104 observations in the manifest whose digest is bound above -- the 52 photographs in two arms each -- to the endpoint and model frozen in scripts/dev/recog_so1_config.json, once. It authorises nothing else: not a re-run on a different corpus, not another provider, not publication of the contact sheets, and not making this repository public.
